name: Thoqqua OLD
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

defensiveAbilities.name: Molten Body
defensiveAbilities.description: A thoqqua's body is hot enough to melt stone. A creature who grabs a thoqqua, is Grabbed by a thoqqua, or critically fails a melee Strike with an unarmed attack or agile weapon takes 1d4 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Thrash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the thoqqua's reach hits the thoqqua with a melee Strike

Effect The thoqqua instinctively thrashes into the attack, pressing its molten hot scales forward. The attacker must attempt a DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The attacker is unaffected.

Success The attacker takes 1d4 Fire Damage damage.

Failure The attacker takes 2d4 Fire Damage damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the weapon used to Strike the thoqqua becomes broken unless the weapon is made of metal, has more than 10 Hardness, or is resistant to or immune to fire.

offensiveAbilities.name: Critical Ignition
offensiveAbilities.description: On a critical hit with a body Strike, a thoqqua inflicts an additional 1d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Starving
offensiveAbilities.description: A thoqqua feeds on a combination of raw stone, ore, and heat. When denied these nourishments, a thoqqua won't perish from starvation, but it does grow less armored as it's forced to absorb and weaken its armored body plates. A starved thoqqua's Armor Class is reduced by 2, but it gains a +1 circumstance bonus on all attack rolls.
